about.title: About me
about.bio_1: I'm a WordPress Developer based in Melbourne, Australia. I enjoy working on custom theme development and high-performance Webflow migrations. I occasionally take on freelance work.
about.bio_2: I've worked with some of the world's most exciting companies, including Coinbase, Stripe, and Linear. I'm passionate about helping startups grow, improve their UX and customer experience, and to fundraise through good design.
about.bio_3: My work has been featured on Typewolf, Mindsparkle Magazine, Webflow, Fonts In Use, CSS Winner, httpster, Siteinspire, and Best Website Gallery.
